name: Lord's, London
projectTitle: mcp-auth-tamarin: formal verification of MCP authorization
landmark: The Victorian pavilion with its balcony; an honours board in the Long Room
tagline: Lord's keeps the Laws of Cricket. This project checks the rules AI agents follow.
facts: Models MCP's authorization flow in the Tamarin prover: 9 protocol models, 376 lemma checks run in CI. Each weakened variant produces an attack trace; the fixed variant verifies. Rediscovered 3 published, already-fixed MCP SDK advisories. Started as his IETF 127 Hackathon project (remote participant). Write-up co-authored with Prince Upadhyay.
panelText: Lord's keeps the Laws of Cricket, so this is where my rules for AI agents live. I modelled MCP's authorization flow in the Tamarin prover: 9 protocol models and 376 lemma checks, all run in CI. Take one check away and the model finds the attack, and along the way it rediscovered 3 published, already-fixed MCP SDK advisories. It started as my IETF 127 Hackathon project (remote participant), and the write-up is co-authored with Prince Upadhyay.

name: Wankhede, Mumbai
landmark: The curved roof canopy, sea breeze, city skyline
tagline: Mumbai is India's money capital. This is software for lenders.
facts: Credit-underwriting software for Indian NBFCs at CredPrism. Gemini 2.5 Flash on Vertex AI checks a borrower's bank statement, GST and bureau data against the lender's own credit-policy PDF. 30+ deterministic forensic checks produce findings the LLM must cite, so every claim in the credit memo traces back to a source cell. PDF highlight lookups take 3–5 s instead of 20–30 s. 580+ tests. A human always makes the credit decision.
panelText: Credit-underwriting software for Indian NBFCs, built at CredPrism. Gemini 2.5 Flash checks a borrower's bank statement, GST and bureau data against the lender's own credit policy, and 30+ deterministic forensic checks back every finding, so every claim in the credit memo traces back to a source cell. A human always makes the credit decision.

name: Galle, Sri Lanka
landmark: The Dutch fort wall along the ground, the clock tower, the sea
tagline: A fort wall guards the ground. Here code guards every number.
facts: Creates posts and client messages for mutual-fund distributors in 4 languages and 7 formats. The LLM never writes a digit: it emits fact placeholders, and code rejects any stray number, including Devanagari and Gujarati digits. LLM compliance reviewer: 100% of violations caught, 0 false positives on a 62-case test; 16/18 on an adversarial red-team set. About ₹2.9 per draft, tracked by a spend ledger with a kill switch.
panelText: A content engine at CredPrism that writes posts and client messages for mutual-fund distributors, in 4 languages and 7 formats. The LLM never writes a digit: it leaves placeholders for the facts, and code rejects any stray number, Devanagari and Gujarati digits included. It runs at about ₹2.9 per draft, with a kill switch on the spend.

name: MCG, Melbourne
projectTitle: Agent-E: multi-agent evaluator for NGO applications
landmark: The vast multi-tier bowl, light towers
tagline: The biggest crowd to judge. Agents that review every applicant.
facts: CrewAI agents score each applicant per criterion with a written justification. RAG over PDF/DOCX submissions (ChromaDB), async jobs on Cloud Run + Cloud Tasks, LangSmith tracing. Cut manual review time by about 70% across 3 program types.
panelText: Agent-E, built at DataSlush: CrewAI agents that score NGO applications criterion by criterion and write down why. It reads PDF and DOCX submissions through RAG over ChromaDB and runs as async jobs on Cloud Run and Cloud Tasks. It cut manual review time by about 70% across 3 program types.
